description: This course explores fundamental challenges in deploying Responsible AI solutions in real-world applications, focusing on issues of privacy, fairness, and trustworthiness. Students will investigate both existing and cutting-edge technical approaches to preserving privacy, ensuring fairness, and verifying AI behavior. The course covers statistical, computational, algorithmic, and systems-oriented strategies, equipping students with the tools to understand and address the challenges to make AI solutions responsible-by-design.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN (( must have completed 1 of CS2109HS/CS2109S/CS3243 at a grade of at least D) AND (( must have completed ST2334 at a grade of at least D) OR (( must have completed 1 of MA2116/MA2116T/ST2131 at a grade of at least D) AND ( must have completed ST2132 at a grade of at least D))))

title: Responsible AI: from Algorithms to Impact
